      protected ClientHttpRequest createRequest(URI uri, HttpMethod httpMethod, ClientHttpRequestFactory requestFactory)
      描述从类复制：AbstractClientHttpRequestFactoryWrapper
      Create a new ClientHttpRequest for the specified URI and HTTP method by using the passed-on request factory.

      由 `AbstractClientHttpRequestFactoryWrapper.createRequest(URI, HttpMethod)` 调用。

      Specified by:
      `AbstractClientHttpRequestFactoryWrapper` 类中的 createRequest
      Parameters:
      uri - 用于创建请求的 URI
      httpMethod - 要执行的 HTTP 方法
      requestFactory - 包装的请求工厂
      Returns:
      已创建的请求
